content.title: Suns at Lakers: How to Watch Live NBA
content.text: How to Watch Lakers vs. Suns on April 10, 2026 You can watch the Phoenix Suns take on the Los Angeles Lakers live on DIRECTV on Spectrum Sportsnet, Scripps or NBA League Pass on April 10, 2026 at 10:30 PM ET. Phoenix Suns at Los Angeles Lakers – Game Preview The Phoenix Suns (43-36) head into a Western Conference matchup with Play-In stakes on the line: The Suns currently hold the seventh seed as the regular season winds down. Phoenix has exceeded expectations after trading Kevin Durant to Houston and parting ways with Bradley Beal before the season, building around Jalen Green and Dillon Brooks in a reboot that has kept them in post-season contention. The Los Angeles Lakers (50-29) are playing back-to-back after Thursday’s trip to Golden State, with the fourth seed in the West already locked up. Los Angeles is managing several injuries, including Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves, which gives Phoenix an opportunity to pick up a road win against a shorthanded Lakers squad before the Play-In Tournament tips off.
